The space
*This is a buyout of 3 units offering a total of 12 bedrooms and a max occupancy of 36.*

Outrider is your key to experiencing Nashville like never before. Just a 5-minute rideshare away from Downtown and Broadway, you'll have access to all the city's excitement against the backdrop of a cool, curated design worthy of all your aesthetic dreams.

It's time to unlock Nashville as it was meant to be experienced. Outrider is ready to show you the city while treating you to style, convenience, and all the comforts of home.other day of Nashville adventures.

We strive to ensure each guest's experience is exceptional. Please note that while the apartment you receive will meet our high standards of comfort and quality, there may be slight variations in layout and design from the images on the listing. Rest assured, your satisfaction is our priority, and we're here to make your stay memorable.

East Nashville is one of Nashville's oldest neighborhoods, located just across the Cumberland River. Known for its eclectic and artsy atmosphere, you'll find some of the city's best restaurants, live music venues, shopping, and easy access to Nissan Stadium. Bonus: all of the excitement of Broadway is just a 10-minute Uber drive away. Don't be surprised if you see one of your favorite musicians walking around this neighborhood, as many of them call it home!

Experience Nashville, AvantStay style.

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we’re at your fingertips!

Other things to note
*Home Truths:*
- Please note our occupancy includes an additional two beyond bed count. Trifold floor mattresses and additional linens can be provided upon request.
- There are 2 flights of stairs present within each unit. Please note these units may not be suitable for guests with mobility issues.
- Units 101 and 107 have been newly redesigned with fun bachelor and bachelorette themes, perfect for groups looking to celebrate and enjoy a stylish, social stay.
